'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Young LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Young]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Joseph Young
* '''Deck name:''' Cloud City
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
